structured_output.what_is_happening: On 22 Sep 2026, in his UN General Assembly speech, Trump said AI should be renamed "super intelligence" (SI) on US government documents. The speech was widely reported (CNBC, The Hill, Gizmodo, Washington Times). A Solana meme coin called "Super Inu" (SI) was already trading on Stonk, paired with tokenized NVIDIA (contract DEW9…). It rose more than 300% and got news coverage at about $7M mcap (KuCoin, ChainCatcher). That token now sits at about $3.4M across 9 pools, with $9.8M in 24h volume on its main pair. The token under study (8Tq9…, PumpSwap, created 19:02 UTC, about 50 minutes old at detection) is a late same-name, same-ticker copy. It has no website, no socials and no DexScreener profile. Its only 'twitter' link on GeckoTerminal is Trump's own post, not a project account. Its structure is extreme: the creator holds about 49% of supply (GMGN creator_hold_rate 0.4925, 'creator_hold'). DexScreener now reports $0 liquidity for this pair, down from about $45k at detection. GeckoTerminal counts 2,062 unique buyers but only 59 unique sellers. GeckoTerminal price change is -17% (m5) and -23% (m15) after an earlier +147% h1 run.

narrative.description: Trump's UN speech renamed AI 'super intelligence' (SI). Meme coins riff on the SI acronym and on 'Super Inu'.
narrative.why_spreading: It is a real, same-day headline from a sitting president, covered by mainstream outlets and quotable ('SI'). Crypto news has already tied it to the Super Inu token. The attention is real, but it goes to the macro story and to the canonical DEW9 token, not to this copy.

token_connection.why_this_token: Only through the shared name and ticker. It launched about 27 hours after the canonical Super Inu, with no socials, and its only link is Trump's post. Nothing ties news or community attention to this contract.
token_connection.competing_tokens: DEW9dSN6QpWyNthphCpMmAbZP1Q4cEKR9xQXAri98WDP (Super Inu on Stonk/NVDAx, ~$3.4M mcap, 9 pools, ~$214k liquidity on its main pool, the one covered by KuCoin/ChainCatcher). There is also another pump copy (1434kF…, ~$5k) and an old 'Super Intelligence' SI (4BjT…, ~$8k).

authenticity.evidence: The creator wallet holds about 49% of supply and top-10 holders hold about 83%. GeckoTerminal shows 2,062 unique buyers against 59 unique sellers, with 927 new buyers in m15 alone. That pattern fits a bot or wallet spray, or misdirected buyers who cannot exit. Fresh-wallet rate is 68%. Liquidity was about $45k at detection and DexScreener now shows $0. The only social link is the President's tweet. I found no organic mentions of this contract anywhere.
authenticity.uncertainty: The $0 liquidity reading may be an indexing quirk for PumpSwap rather than LP removal. The large buyer count could partly be real people confusing this token with the canonical Super Inu.

structural_risks: The creator holds ~49% of supply, a very large overhang that could be dumped at any time
DexScreener now reports $0 liquidity (was ~$45k at detection)
Unique sellers are only ~3% of unique buyers
Price is already reversing (-17% m5, -23% m15 on GeckoTerminal)
A far larger canonical token with the same name and ticker soaks up the attention

structured_output.counterargument: The Trump 'super intelligence' story is real, fresh and big. Spillover and confused buyers can briefly lift copycat tickers, and 2,000+ buyers in 30 minutes shows real flow. If the canonical token runs again, sympathy bids could push this one briefly. The $0 liquidity reading could be a data artefact rather than a rug.
unknowns: Whether liquidity was actually pulled or this is a reporting glitch
Whether the creator has already sold part of the 49% stake
Whether any KOL or Telegram call channel is pushing this particular contract (X was not indexed)
The makeup of the 2,062 buyers (bots vs people)

source_coverage.notes: News covers only the Trump speech and the canonical Super Inu (Stonk/NVDAx). Nothing mentions contract 8Tq9…. Trump's X post returned 403 (inaccessible). The project has no site or socials in the packet or on DexScreener. Discord was not attempted because no server is linked anywhere.

structured_output.thesis: The narrative is real, but this is a late PumpSwap copy of the canonical Super Inu. The creator holds ~49% of supply, liquidity now reads $0, and there are only 59 sellers against 2,000+ buyers. Its attention is borrowed and its structure is extractive, so it is likely to fade or rug.
